characters.notes: Uses the One Power extensively in this chapter: removes fatigue from horses and riders, creates fog to hide them from the Draghkar
Draws Tam's sword instinctively when Draghkar attacks; seems to have unusual connection to Bela (wills her to run and she does); others notice him drawing the sword
Full name revealed in this chapter; previously known only as 'the gleeman'

stable_traits.physical_traits: wears her hair in a braid, rides Bela

characters.notes: Shows excitement and delight during the dangerous ride rather than fear; Moiraine has enhanced Bela beyond simply removing fatigue

stable_traits.personality: weary, hungry, makes jokes even under stress

characters.notes: Has never been further than Watch Hill before this journey

stable_traits.physical_traits: gray horse, smoky-colored, strong and fast, competitive
stable_traits.personality: spirited, competitive, wants to race and win

characters.notes: Strains to catch Lan's black stallion; panics badly during Draghkar attack

Moiraine says she has a good heart and as much stubbornness as Two Rivers folk; may be the least weary of all horses; Moiraine has done something beyond removing fatigue to allow her to keep up with larger horses

stable_traits.physical_traits: narrow face with pointed features, bare ankles, wears nightshirt
stable_traits.personality: suspicious, greedy, cowardly around the fog

characters.notes: Mat mocks his name saying he never even saw a high tower; operates the ferry across the Taren; has haulers who work for him
Mentioned in context of Rand carrying his sword and in reference to Moiraine having used the One Power on him

appearances.whereabouts: Leading the group on horseback from near Emond's Field northward on the North Road, through Watch Hill, to Taren Ferry
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the desperate flight north at a gallop; scans the sky for the Draghkar with sword drawn; commands the party to spread out, then allows them to cluster when they refuse; does not slow pace even in the fog; pounds on Master Hightower's door and negotiates passage on the ferry with gold
appearances.demeanor: Alert, commanding, urgent, determined, unwavering despite danger

appearances.whereabouts: Riding with the group from near Emond's Field north to Taren Ferry
appearances.notable_actions: Removes fatigue from all the horses using the One Power; does something extra to Bela to make her able to keep pace with larger horses; creates a massive fog to hide the party from the Draghkar and confuse the Myrddraal; explains she cannot kill a Draghkar from horseback; states she will use the Myrddraal's slyness against it
appearances.demeanor: Calm, confident, strategic, powerful, unfatigued despite exertion

appearances.whereabouts: Riding at the rear of the group from near Emond's Field to Taren Ferry, on Cloud
appearances.notable_actions: Rides last in line to watch for pursuit; struggles to control Cloud who wants to race; desperately wills Bela to run faster, experiencing strange sensations (prickling skin, freezing bones) when he does so; draws Tam's sword instinctively when Draghkar attacks, then awkwardly sheathes it; nearly dragged off his feet when Cloud panics; eventually gains control of the horse; rides through the fog to Taren Ferry; inadvertently pushes ahead of Lan when they arrive
appearances.demeanor: Anxious about Egwene and Bela, determined not to leave them behind, embarrassed when he makes mistakes, uncomfortable with Moiraine's use of the One Power, protective

appearances.whereabouts: Riding just ahead of Rand in the fleeing group, from near Emond's Field to Taren Ferry
appearances.notable_actions: Never turns his head to look behind, only forward; suggests stopping for rest in Watch Hill; rides through the chaos of the Draghkar attack
appearances.demeanor: Focused, pragmatic, weary from the ride

appearances.whereabouts: Riding Bela with the fleeing group from near Emond's Field to Taren Ferry
appearances.notable_actions: Rides Bela who keeps pace with the larger horses; shouts at Rand to hurry during the Draghkar attack; rides with apparent excitement and delight
appearances.demeanor: Excited, delighted by the adventure, brave, smiling despite danger

appearances.whereabouts: Riding with the fleeing group from near Emond's Field to Taren Ferry
appearances.notable_actions: Expresses desire for rest, food, and celebration in Watch Hill; makes a sarcastic joke about Master Hightower's name; struggles with his frightened horse during the Draghkar attack
appearances.demeanor: Tired, hungry, maintaining humor despite stress and fear

appearances.whereabouts: Riding with the fleeing group from near Emond's Field to Taren Ferry
appearances.notable_actions: Expresses desire for food and hot tea; struggles with his frightened horse during the Draghkar attack
appearances.demeanor: Weary, cold, focused on basic comforts

appearances.whereabouts: Carrying Rand from near Emond's Field to Taren Ferry
appearances.notable_actions: Runs at full gallop, straining to catch and pass Lan's black stallion; fights Rand for control; panics violently when the Draghkar attacks, rearing and screaming, nearly dragging Rand to the ground; eventually calms after landing hard; runs through the fog; briefly surges ahead when they reach Taren Ferry
appearances.demeanor: Competitive, spirited, terrified during Draghkar attack, then exhausted (lathered, head down, sides heaving) before Moiraine refreshes him

appearances.whereabouts: Carrying Egwene from near Emond's Field to Taren Ferry
appearances.notable_actions: Runs at a pace Rand didn't think possible, keeping up with the much larger horses; responds to Rand's desperate mental commands to run; runs a few steps when the Draghkar screams before Egwene reins her in; runs with neck outstretched and tail and mane streaming
appearances.demeanor: Determined, running beyond her apparent natural ability, perhaps the least weary of all the horses

appearances.whereabouts: In his house in Taren Ferry, then at the door
appearances.notable_actions: Answers Lan's pounding on his door in his nightshirt; initially refuses to take them across in the night and fog; changes his mind when Lan counts out gold coins; agrees to rouse his haulers and take them across immediately
appearances.demeanor: Suspicious, angry at being woken, fearful of the fog, greedy for gold, calculating

appearances.notable_actions: None in this chapter; his sword is carried by Rand

relationships.description: Moiraine is Aes Sedai and Lan is her bonded Warder; they work together seamlessly, he leads physically while she provides magical support
Tam is Rand's father; Rand carries Tam's sword on this journey
Rand rides Cloud and struggles to maintain control over the spirited, competitive horse
Egwene rides Bela; Rand notes Egwene can rein Bela in
Rand has a protective concern for Bela and seems able to mentally will her to run faster; Moiraine confirms Rand was 'right about your Bela'
Rand is determined not to let Egwene fall behind, willing to drop back with her even if it means facing the Fade and Trollocs
Friends from the Two Rivers, fleeing together
